about_the_game:
You awaken in a moving subway train, with no memories and no exit in sight. Trapped with 4 other strangers, you must solve your captor’s puzzles to get into the subsequent cars, and escape. What are you willing to do to get out? Will you play by the rules, or break them?

  • Investigate each themed car to learn about the how's and why's of your situation

  • Meet an eccentric and colorful cast that challenge the protagonist and her unorthodox methods

  • Find the solutions for several puzzles to progress

  • Nonlinear story with branching choices and multiple endings

  • Unique art-style with a mixture of photography, digital artwork and practical props!

Project B-FER was originally a 2 week long game jam project that was fully live-streamed with audience participation. Prime Cut serves as a director's cut, where the team has expanded on the original story. We seek to refine our original vision and add more content with new lore, art, routes, and endings.
